invariants.description: Every inference feature must represent the same semantic variable expected during training.
invariants.evidence: Asserted equality across FEATURE_NAMES semantics between DataGenerator.encode_features and preprocess_transaction.

invariants.description: Feature order at inference must exactly match training order.
invariants.evidence: DataGenerator.encode_features enforces df[FEATURE_NAMES] re-indexing, preventing dictionary or column order permutation.

invariants.description: The same intended transformation semantics (categorical indices and reference bounds) must apply during training and inference.
invariants.evidence: Shared REFERENCE_BOUNDS and authoritative list indices applied identically in training and inference.

invariants.description: A model artifact must be loaded only with a compatible feature and model schema without silent corrupting dimension mismatch.
invariants.evidence: Dynamic state_dict layer shape inspection in _get_cached_serving_model and _load_challenger_model with explicit warning logging on alignment.

invariants.description: An inference result must identify the model version that actually produced it.
invariants.evidence: ModelEvaluationEngine logs champion_version, challenger_version, and routed_to for every scored transaction.

invariants.description: Raw model output, logits, probabilities, scores, and labels must not be conflated.
invariants.evidence: Verified FraudDetectionModel final layer is nn.Sigmoid() producing single probability in [0, 1]; composite risk score scales to [0, 1000]; binary threshold applies at score >= 600.0.

invariants.description: Sigmoid probability transformation must occur exactly once.
invariants.evidence: Verified _eval_model and _eval_model_batch do not re-apply sigmoid to model output.

invariants.description: The threshold used for classification must be the intended threshold associated with that inference path.
invariants.evidence: Decision threshold is_fraud_suspected = score >= 600.0 consistently applied across single and batch responses.

invariants.description: A model in evaluation mode given identical deterministic input must produce equivalent output.
invariants.evidence: Repeated forward evaluations under torch.no_grad() produce identical outputs.

invariants.description: Single-record inference and equivalent one-record batch inference must agree within numerical tolerance.
invariants.evidence: Aligned feature store enrichment and tensor batching ensure infer(A) == infer_batch([A])[0] and preserve row ordering.

invariants.description: Cached models must be bound to mtime, version, and simulation identity.
invariants.evidence: _get_cached_serving_model checks mtime on global_model.pt; challenger models keyed by (simulation_id, version, dp_compatible).

invariants.description: Undefined metrics must not silently become fabricated valid values that trigger false governance actions.
invariants.evidence: Added is_roc_auc_defined, is_pr_auc_defined, compute_roc_auc_with_status, and protected ModelEvaluationEngine rollback gating.

invariants.description: Inference and model loading failures must fail closed and never silently return fabricated predictions or uninitialized random weights.
invariants.evidence: Removed silent random weight fallback on state_dict loading failure; added non-finite (NaN/Inf) rejection in preprocessing and eval.

invariants.description: Tenant inference state must remain isolated.
invariants.evidence: enforce_tenant_isolation rejects cross-tenant requests; metered tenant quotas enforced per bank.
